# Cressida Lindsay

## Overview

- **Age:** Eighteen years old (volume 3)  <sub>[v3 c4 P52](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0052)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Harborough, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032)</sub>
- **Role:** College student at Wexcombe  <sub>[v3 c4 P46](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0046)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Cressy  <sub>[v3 c4 P25](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0025)</sub>

## Appearance

Cressida is an unevenly, strikingly beautiful girl with dark, plush brown eyes under dark, black eyebrows, glossy dark hair, and a charming, asymmetrical mouth with red lips and a dimple on one side. She is self-conscious about her nose and her figure, which she worries will become stout as she ages. She dresses in elegant, stylish gowns and takes great pride in her looks and clothes.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020), [v3 c4 P40](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0040), [v3 c4 P56](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0056), [v3 c5 P1](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0001), [v3 c19 P11](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0011), [v3 c19 P13](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0013)_

## Personality

Cressida is vivacious, affectionate, candid, and openly enjoys the company of suitors and social gatherings. She admits to being terribly indecisive, impulsive, and prone to dramatic exaggeration, yet she possesses a good-natured, unselfish, and loyal heart beneath her lighthearted surface. Although she claims to lack seriousness, she is capable of deep devotion, hard study, and firm resolve when her heart is genuinely engaged.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P25](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0025), [v3 c4 P46](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0046), [v3 c4 P60](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0060), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003), [v3 c20 P21](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0021), [v3 c24 P20](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0020), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)_

- To enjoy life, fun, and social attention before settling down  <sub>[v3 c4 P48](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0048)</sub>
- To marry Ezra Hale and support his ministry  <sub>[v3 c24 P20](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0020), [v3 c27 P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019)</sub>

## History

Cressida attends Wexcombe College as a Freshman, where she becomes close friends with Nell Harcourt and Honora Hollis. She quickly becomes the beauty and social favorite of her class, attracting many suitors. During her second year, she rents Tabby's Place alongside Nell, Honora, and Mabel Colby under the housekeeping of Aunt Euphemia. While summering at Prospect Point, she meets Ezra Hale, an earnest theology student, and unexpectedly falls in love with him. In her Senior year at Wexcombe, she excels in Mathematics and earns the Johnson Scholarship. She eventually accepts Ezra Hale's proposal of marriage, agreeing to live a simple life as a minister's wife.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c10 P13](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0013), [v3 c10 P52](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0052), [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c26 P3](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0003), [v3 c27 P15](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0015), [v3 c27 P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019)_
